KVS NVS Teaching & Non-Teaching Tier-II Result 2026

Post Date: August 18, 2026

10:47 am

Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS) & Navodaya Vidyalaya Sangathan (NVS), has released the Tier-II Result on the official website for the KVS NVS Teaching & Non-Teaching Examination 2026. The tier-II exam was conducted From 27-31 March 2026, and the last date to submit the application form was 11 December 2025. Candidates can check their Tier-II Result using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link is provided below.
